text:
My first impression of Google Omni. It’s a decent to solid upgrade from Veo 3s. The renders come out clean and beautiful, thankfully no weird HDR glow.

​That said, if you approach it like a magic cinema generator where you just drop a two-line prompt and expect a cine output, you’re gonna be disappointed. It really rewards solid, accurate prompting.

​The physics can still be a bit of a gremlin, which gets frustrating. You can write a solid prompt and it’ll still just do whatever it wants 😂. But when it lands it is legitimately good.

​Basically, you just need to approach it like you're directing an assistant editor. Overall a pretty sweet deal.
